LibraryMaintenance.MenuHint: Consolidate, export, or import the shared audio library — recovery and moving-installation tools, not part of the daily workflow.
LibraryMaintenance.Title: Library Maintenance
LibraryMaintenance.Intro: These tools work on the library shared by every world on this Foundry installation. That sharing is convenient, but it also means the library is not part of any single world's backup and does not follow you to another machine on its own — the actions below exist for exactly that gap.

Export.Title: Export a Copy
Export.Description: Download library.json to your computer. This is the real backup: the data folder it normally lives in is not part of a Foundry world backup, so a copy saved outside Foundry entirely is the only one a mistake here cannot reach.

Import.Title: Import a Catalogue
Import.Description: Read a library.json exported from another installation — merge its rows into what is already here, or replace this catalogue with it entirely. Neither mode checks that the files themselves exist on this machine: a path missing here may still be correct on the next one.

Consolidate.Title: Consolidate into the Data Folder
Consolidate.Description: Copy every library file into this module's own data folder, renamed to a tidy lower-case form. Useful before moving to a new machine, since a library can otherwise point at files scattered across many locations. The most destructive tool here: originals are never deleted (Foundry's file API has no delete), so this permanently doubles the disk space the library uses. Always preview the plan before running it.

Packs.Title: Content Packs
Packs.Description: Modules that build soundboards, ambiences and playlists here through the Audio Console API. A pack only ever adds on load; it never changes what you have tuned since. Sync is how you take a newer pack version's changes, when you decide to.
Packs.Empty: No content pack is registered in this world.
Packs.SyncQuestion: Bring the {count} containers of “{name}” back in line with what the pack ships?
Packs.SyncOverwrites: On the pack's own sounds, boards and library rows this overwrites what the pack defines: volume, loop, icon, colour, random timing; board colour, fade, shuffle, favourite; track name, channel and volume in the library.
Packs.SyncKeeps: Kept as they are: every name you gave a board, any sound you added to a pack's board yourself, any board you built, and every tag you added. A container you deleted is built again.

Notify.Synced: “{name}” synced: {containers} containers, {entriesUpdated} sounds updated, {entriesAdded} added, {rowsUpdated} library rows updated.
Notify.Failed: Syncing “{name}” failed — see the console for details.
